news.headline: Santos popped up on Friday's injury report as a DNP due to a right hip issue, but he was a full participant in Saturday'
news.detail: Santos popped up on Friday's injury report as a DNP due to a right hip issue, but he was a full participant in Saturday's session and has been cleared to play Monday night. He's gone 2-for-3 on field-goal attempts and 8-for-8 on extra-point tries through the first two games of the regular season.
